arStrings.szText: A Barrier formed by Deep Freeze that generates Mana every second.

{c_important}Deep Freeze{/c} forms a {u}{c_important}Barrier{/c}{/u} that absorbs {c_number}{shield:UPGRADEA_BARRIER_TOOLTIP}{/c}{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}([{SF_11}*100|%|] of Maximum Life){/if} damage every second while active.

This {u}{c_important}Barrier{/c}{/u} grants {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} Mana Regeneration.

{c_important}Deep Freeze's{/c} continuous and final explosion damage become Frostbite damage that deals {c_number}{dot:UPGRADEB_FROSTBITE_TOOLTIP}{/c} and {c_number}{dot:UPGRADEB_EXPLOSION_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage over {c_number}{buffDuration:UPGRADEB_FROSTBITE}{/c} seconds respectively.

This Frostbite damage {u}{c_important}Chills{/c}{/u} for {c_number}[SF_10 * (SF_16 / SF_17)|%|]{/c} over {c_number}{buffDuration:UPGRADEB_FROSTBITE}{/c} seconds and will remove {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/c}{/u} from enemies.

Instead of encasing yourself and becoming {u}{c_important}Immune{/c}{/u}, {c_important}Deep Freeze{/c} now forms at the target location dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_WAVE_DAMAGE}{/c} damage continuously and {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_FINAL_DAMAGE}{/c} explosion damage.

You remain free to act during the duration and {c_important}Deep Freeze{/c} now has {c_number}{SF_20}{/c} Charges.
Damage makes enemies {u}{c_important}Vulnerable{/c}{/u} and {u}{c_important}Weakened{/c}{/u} for {c_number}[SF_24]{/c} seconds.
Reduces your Cooldowns by {c_resource}{SF_25}{/c} second and generate {c_resource}{SF_28}{/c} Mana every second while active.
Cooldown speed is increased by {c_number}[SF_27 * 100|%|]{/c} while you have a {u}{c_important}Barrier{/c}{/u}.
